name: Humanitarian funding gap
value: WFP Gaza cuts; Sudan shelter aid at 10%
summary: WFP ended monthly aid to 500,000 in Gaza; UN says Sudan shelter aid reaches only 10% in need; no full suspension
state: WFP said on 19 Oct that a funding shortfall would end monthly aid to 500,000 people in Gaza and shrink rations for the 1.1 million still reached, having received about half its usual funding for the Palestinian territories in 2026 (Khaleej Times, citing AFP). On 6 Nov the UN said only about 10% of the 15.4 million people in Sudan needing emergency shelter could be prioritised, and IOM said its Sudan warehouses were empty (Reuters via bdnews24). Major ration cuts meet Watch; no large-scale suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country was found as of 17 Nov.
for_you: Cuts fall hardest on people in Gaza and displaced families in Sudan heading into winter. Aid agencies warn that shortfalls tend to show up later as rising malnutrition and disease.
rubric_hit: Major ration cuts announced (WFP Gaza, 500,000 cut from monthly aid) meet Watch; no pipeline break suspending aid at scale

sources.title: UN World Food Programme to end monthly aid for 500,000 in Gaza
UN warns of shelter shortfall for millions displaced in Sudan

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
